import Definitions.Def_FermatProperDivisorHeight

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped Classical
formal_statement:
theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.canonicalDifferentialChange : ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M),
  AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ResiduesFinite M →
    ∀ (φ : ↥M.K),
      Transcendental ℚ φ →
        ∀ (K : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.CanonicalDivisorData M hDVR),
          ∃ (q : ↥M.K),
            q ≠ 0 ∧
              ∀ (P : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place ↥M.K),
                K.D P =
                  (if φ ∈ ↑P then AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1
                    else -AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1) +
                    AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ord M hDVR P q := by sorry

import Definitions.Def_FermatProperDivisorHeight

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped Classical
formal_statement:
theorem AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.belyiCanonicalCuspCoefficientIdentity : ∀ {N : ℕ} (M : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Model N) (hDVR : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.PlacesDiscrete M),
  AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ResiduesFinite M →
    ∀ (φ : ↥M.K),
      AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.IsBelyi M hDVR φ →
        ∀ (hfin : (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cusps M hDVR φ).Finite)
          (P : AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.Place ↥M.K),
          (if φ ∈ ↑P then AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1
              else -AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1) +
              (AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.cuspDivisor M hDVR φ hfin) P =
            AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.poleMultiplicity M hDVR φ P +
              AbcAdaptation.Tripod.Fermat.Proper.ord M hDVR P (φ * (φ - 1)) := by sorry
